newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss sight deposits fall to 3,354.5 million Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss sight deposits fall to 3,354.5 million Sfr.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank said sight deposits fell by 139.1 million Swiss francs to 3,354.5 million in the reporting period ended February 10.
Statement of February 11 in millions of Swiss francs:
Borrowing at the emergency Lombard window rose by 5.4 million francs to 5.4 million in the reporting period, from nil in the previous week.
Outstanding borrowing via the discount facility and swaps of money market certificates rose by 1,591.3 million francs to 1,873.9 million.
An SNB spokesman said there was nothing unusual in the latest data, adding that the slight decline in sight deposits followed recent high levels of liquidity.

The spokesman added that the Swiss National Bank had not deviated from its policy outlined in December, in that it would hold to an expansionary monetary policy as long as there was no clear sign of recovery in the Swiss economy. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
